name: Professor Oak
description: The world's most famous Pokémon researcher, inventor of the Pokédex, and the one who started millions of journeys with 'Are you a boy or a girl?'

name: Professor Elm
description: Oak's former student and the leading expert on Pokémon breeding — he discovered that Pokémon hatch from Eggs.

name: Professor Birch
description: Hoenn's field-work professor, best remembered for being chased by a wild Poochyena until you save him.

name: Professor Rowan
description: The stern authority on Pokémon evolution — roughly 90% of all Pokémon are said to be linked to evolution in his research.

name: Professor Juniper
description: The first female lead professor in the main games, studying the origins of Pokémon species.

name: Professor Sycamore
description: The charming Kalos professor who pioneered Mega Evolution research — and actually battles you himself.

name: Professor Kukui
description: Alola's shirtless move-researcher who secretly moonlights as the Masked Royal in Battle Royals.

name: Professor Magnolia
description: The elegant scientist who unraveled the Dynamax phenomenon powering Galar's stadium battles.

name: Professor Sada
description: Paldea's professor of ancient Pokémon in Scarlet — her story hides one of the series' biggest twists.

name: Professor Turo
description: Paldea's professor of future Pokémon in Violet, obsessed with the technology of tomorrow.

name: Blue
description: Your original rival — he became Champion moments before you arrived to take the title from him. Smell ya later!

name: Lance
description: The caped Dragon master of the Elite Four and Johto Champion, famous for his (technically impossible) Lv. 40 Dragonites.

name: Steven Stone
description: Hoenn's stone-collecting Champion, heir to the Devon Corporation and master of Steel types.

name: Wallace
description: The Sootopolis Gym Leader who rose to Champion in Emerald — an artist who battles with water.

name: Cynthia
description: Widely considered the strongest Champion of all time — her Garchomp has ended more win streaks than any Pokémon in history.

name: Alder
description: Unova's wandering Champion, who battles to honor his lost partner Pokémon.

name: Iris
description: The dragon prodigy from Opelucid who becomes Unova's Champion in Black 2 & White 2.

name: Diantha
description: Kalos's Champion and a world-famous movie star who Mega Evolves her Gardevoir.

name: Leon
description: Galar's undefeated Champion with a legendary sense of direction — as in, he has none.

name: Geeta
description: The Top Champion of Paldea and chairwoman of the Pokémon League itself.

name: Red
description: The silent legend. After becoming Kanto Champion, he vanished to the summit of Mt. Silver awaiting the strongest challengers.

name: Ash Ketchum
description: The anime's eternal 10-year-old from Pallet Town, who finally became World Champion after 25 years of trying.

name: Misty
description: Cerulean's Water-type leader and Ash's first traveling companion — still waiting for that bike.

name: Brock
description: Pewter's Rock-solid leader turned Pokémon breeder, doctor-in-training, and hopeless romantic.

name: Jessie
description: One half of Team Rocket's most persistent (and least successful) trio, blasting off again since 1997.

name: James
description: Team Rocket's gentle-hearted rose enthusiast, whose Pokémon love him a little too aggressively.

name: Meowth
description: The talking Meowth of Team Rocket who taught himself human speech for love — and got roasted for it.

name: Giovanni
description: The boss of Team Rocket, secret Viridian Gym Leader, and mastermind behind Mewtwo's creation.

name: N
description: The puppet king of Team Plasma who can hear Pokémon voices — one of the series' most beloved and tragic figures.

name: Ghetsis
description: Team Plasma's true mastermind, who raised N as a tool to rule Unova — and owns an infamously brutal Hydreigon.

name: Lysandre
description: The Team Flare boss who planned to wipe the world clean with the ultimate weapon to preserve its beauty.

name: Guzma
description: The self-proclaimed 'destruction in human form,' boss of Team Skull and Alola's angriest Bug-type specialist.

name: Cyrus
description: Team Galactic's emotionless boss who tried to delete the universe and rebuild it without human spirit.

name: Lillie
description: The gentle companion of the Alola games whose growth from fearful girl to trainer is a fan-favorite arc. Get in the bag, Nebby.

name: Hop
description: Leon's little brother and your Galar rival, who grows from Champion-chaser to professor's assistant.

name: Nemona
description: Paldea's battle-obsessed Champion-rank rival who deliberately starts with the starter weak to yours — for fun.

name: Gary Oak
description: The anime's original smug rival with his own cheerleading squad, who matured into a Pokémon researcher like his grandfather.

name: Looker
description: The International Police detective who pops up in nearly every region, chasing villainous teams across the world.
